requirement: The system shall support user account registration and login with identity validation, duplicate-account checks, and failure feedback.

The system shall support favoriting and unfavoriting scores, following and unfollowing users, and favoriting models and managing personal model lists, and shall persist the corresponding favorite and follow records.
The system shall support web-based score generation from a selected model and source music, and support uploading generated scores for persistent storage.
The system shall support score search by song name, hot-chart browsing, and score download as content discovery and retrieval functions.
The system shall support retrieving personalized recommendation lists based on user favorites, follows, and similarity information, with random fallback when no playlist exists.

The algorithm service shall support daily training and update of per-user generation models from user playlists, including midi-to-abc preprocessing, model-parameter persistence, and exception notification to the scheduler when midi conversion fails.

The algorithm module shall generate a MIDI score from a seed score through conversion, track-seed extraction, and generation, retry failed conversion, and notify the backend to restore model parameters after two failed attempts.
The algorithm service shall support classifying all scores using generated score representations, persisting classification labels, and notifying the backend when midi conversion fails.
The system shall update score hot charts and user hot charts based on attention and popularity rules.

The scheduling module shall orchestrate daily and user-triggered tasks through queue submission, status polling, logging, and retry handling for training, classification, recommendation, and generation jobs.
The system shall use replicated storage and remain usable during partial failures.
The system shall present simple, beginner-friendly interactions with instructions, prompts, and guidance.
